aiSummary: The data shows a high-volume, value-driven strategy around boAt BassHeads wired earphones in India: a sale price of 499 INR (list price 999 INR) with strong momentum (5K+ units purchased in the last month) indicates aggressive discounting to win market share in a price-sensitive category. Brand strength is evident—the boAt brand with a clear slogan, top seller ranks (5th in Electronics, 2nd in In-Ear Headphones), and a vivid multi-variant color strategy (Active White, Raging Black, Active Black, Off White Orange, etc.) supported by rich media and A+ content, suggesting a plug-and-play conversion machine on Amazon.in. The core product delivers solid audio signals (10 mm dynamic drivers, 16 ohm impedance, Type-C wired connection) and favorable sentiment on overall sound and bass, aligning with value-for-money positioning. However, there are notable quality and usability risks that could erode margins and drive returns: reliability concerns (microphone and intermittent one-side failures) and fit/comfort issues (ear tips/ear-hug ergonomics leading to discomfort and ear-fatigue) are repeatedly highlighted in reviews, despite a large positive base (approx. 60–65% positive sentiment across key metrics). This creates a dual-persona dynamic: price-conscious buyers reward value and sound quality, while a meaningful segment experiences durability and fit pain, potentially inflating warranty costs and negative word-of-mouth. The product page shows a well-structured ecosystem: multiple SKUs (variantAsins 8+), a dedicated seller, and an established store presence with visible reviews, delivery promises, and a high Best Sellers Rank, signaling effective distribution but also channel risk if supply or quality slips. Opportunities include leveraging the strong price-to-performance ratio while addressing the pain points: invest in ergonomic redesign and improved mic durability, expand warranty or offer quick-replace policies, optimize ear-tip sizing and fit, and consider a refreshed BassHeads line (e.g., 300C Pro) at a slightly higher price to sustain margins; bolster post-purchase service, and continue differentiated content to convert comparison shoppers. Overall, BoAt can sustain growth by balancing volume-driven pricing with targeted product improvements and robust after-sales support to convert and retain the otherwise favorable yet caution-prone voice of the customer.

features: Type-C Jack & 120cm Cable: Plug into effortless audio with the boAt BassHeads 300C Wired Earphones. Featuring a Type-C connector, these earphones let you connect without fumbling on long travels or daily commutes. Designed with a 120cm cable, these earphones offer ease of movement while keeping your style on point and your audio within reach.

10mm Drivers with boAt Signature Sound: Dive into deep, thumping beats with the powerful 10mm drivers that deliver boAt Signature Sound. Whether you're streaming a series or vibing to your favourite tracks, enjoy crisp, bass-rich audio every time.
Hawk-inspired Design: Drawing inspiration from the sleek and powerful hawk, these earphones sport sharp contours and a bold silhouette that turns heads wherever you go.

In-Line Microphone: Stay connected on the move with the built-in mic that lets you take calls without reaching for your phone. From virtual meetings to chats with friends, communication stays clear and convenient.
Integrated Controls: Manage your audio like a pro with the easy-to-access multi-functional button. Skip tracks, play or pause music, or answer calls - all at your fingertips with BassHeads 300C.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Great wired earphones for the price
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I bought these boAt Type-C wired earphones for everyday use and I’m quite satisfied with them. The sound quality is clear, vocals are good, and the bass is decent for regular music and videos. They’re lightweight and comfortable to use for longer periods.The Type-C connection is convenient, especially with newer phones, and I haven’t faced any connection issues so far. Overall, a simple and reliable pair of wired earphones at a reasonable price.

The build quality also feels good and the earphones are comfortable to use.I’ve tried many earphones before, but the sound of these really surprised me. The bass especially reminds me of the sound I love from the BassHeads 225. 🤯🔥Great job boAt! This is definitely one of my favorite wired earphones. ❤️🎧
